proposals.impact: remove banned diagnostic crutch from published title to protect brand voice
proposals.observation: Yesterday's published blog post carries the title "Prices are up and you're avoiding your numbers. Here's what's happening in your brain." The second sentence is a direct diagnostic crutch ("Here's what's happening") which appears verbatim on the banned structural patterns list. It also reads as a generic hook that could appear on any personal finance site. The Sultanic test fails: 1,000 other coaches could write this exact sentence. The title is live and indexed, so the fix needs to happen in the content file, not a draft.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the second sentence of the blog title to remove the diagnostic crutch and pass the Sultanic test. The replacement should stay close in character count to avoid disrupting any social previews already scheduled, and should be specific enough that only Joel, with his behavioural economics background, could plausibly have written it. One frontmatter field edit in the published file.
